searchText: Having the signature travel separately in a dependency frame is not a bad idea. Though I would immediately start thinking that someone does some type of aggregation even before we have in-mempool aggregation. Notably if these are more centralized parties to start with (e.g. block builders) they would not have to do recursive aggregation which afaik was a big source of uncertainty about timelines. I totally agree with this. We could have aggregation too if we start with builders or some other parties. Mempool aggregation could come later whenever we want since it doesn’t require a hard fork It’d be even better if we do the recursive aggregation now, so it’s another thing that we don’t need to do later Another benefit of doing segregation now and having the dependency frame is that later, you don’t have to do it + adding leanPCS on top of it is straightforward We should aim for aggregation too and cut it in case we need to because of timelines
